description: Make Runner presence expiry restart-safe and retry the existing generation-fenced closeout obligation without adding a second ledger.

tasks.title: Persist and supervise the Runner presence lease
tasks.description: Persist PresenceLeaseExpiresAt at field ID 6, renew it from real presence, rebuild reminder supervision on activation, converge elapsed and legacy state fail-closed, and make registry eligibility ask the Runner authority.
acceptanceCriteria: The absolute UTC lease is persisted before online registry publication and remains exactly two minutes.
The ten-second timer is only low-latency; the existing presence reminder supervises activation-safe expiry.
Future activation does not renew, elapsed activation does not renew, and missing legacy expiry remains offline.
Unregister clears the lease before registry removal.
Eligibility omits false or unavailable Runner authority reads while ListAll remains diagnostic.
Focused fake-time and explicit activation/reminder tests cover the lease matrix without wall-clock polling.
tasks.output: Durable Runner presence lease and lease-authoritative eligibility.
tasks.notes: Implemented and verified against current master with focused lease/reactivation/eligibility coverage and full repository gates.

tasks.title: Retry the existing generation-fenced Runner-loss closeout
tasks.description: Keep ClosingProcessGeneration as the sole durable obligation, attempt both existing owner scans independently, retain on Outstanding/query/delivery exception, and redrive on activation and presence reminder.
acceptanceCriteria: ClosingProcessGeneration is durable before closeout and remains until both owner scans are definitive.
Existing generation-fenced Workflow and AgentJob fail methods remain the only owner delivery APIs.
Accepted and Refused are definitive; Outstanding, unavailable reads, load failures, and exceptions retain the generation.
One owner failure does not prevent attempts to other owners, and checks preserve their generation fence.
Reminder and activation retry the same generation without a per-owner ledger, deadline matrix, queue, or Runner journal.
Focused tests cover first-failure retry, activation retry, isolation, generation fence, and idempotency.
tasks.output: Retryable existing generation closeout with no second durable ledger.
tasks.notes: Implemented with ClosingProcessGeneration as the sole durable obligation; accepted/refused are definitive, outstanding/exceptions retain and reminder/activation redrive.
